text: The interaction item, the append command and the intake result use the element names written in this story: occurredAt, channel, eventCode, sourceSystem, direction, contactResult, contactKey, caseSeq and the entry ID for the read; case, entry type, channel, occurred time, contact key, result and the Idempotency-Key for the append; businessDate, rowsRead, written, excluded and notOnCase for the intake result.
why: The sources name the operations and the Java interfaces but not the JSON element names, and the Ownership Map moves the two interaction operations to rwb-source-data.

impact: Renames only; no value, rule, criterion or test changes

text: The merged timeline is sequenced by occurred time and then by the case sequence, while the page order of the screen stays the newest-first order of the case timeline contract of RWB-P3-E2016-CON.
why: The legacy story, its AC3 and AC9 and REQ-ILG-006 read occurred-time order with the case sequence on a tie, and the case timeline contract serves newest first; the sources do not settle which governs the screen.
read: RWB-E2-034 BR9, AC3, AC9; REQ-ILG-006; FSD P3 A2.45 AC-P3-045-01; RWB-P3-E2016-CON
confirm: Architecture and the case timeline contract owner
impact: The tie-break and the sequence are fixed for the merged list; the screen order follows the timeline contract

text: The ledger source timeout, the page size default and maximum, the source, channel and entry-type labels and the contact mask of a role are parameter rows of rwb-case and reference rows of rwb-case read at run time, and the mask is applied by the ACE common masking path.
why: The legacy story holds the page size, the filters and the masking as configuration and screen behaviour and names none of the values; the target moves parameters and reference data to the contracts of DP-06 and DP-07 and masking to DP-08.
read: RWB-E2-034 sections 4, 13 and 17; TSD P3 v3 T-A.1; Template and Rules R5.5 DP-06, DP-07 and DP-08
